guard.loading: Test setup dynamically loads this exact existing guard and checks its canonical Git blob SHA. No replacement or mocked guard. Missing audit module imports before guard setup for a proper initial missing-module RED.

report_shape: Pure API returns exactly these top-level fields. reason exists only for HOLD. Counts axes are exactly observation and rejection, each containing exactly the twelve named nonnegative integer counters (not booleans). Only origin AES_BASE is accepted; untrusted origin is never echoed. I/O wrapper metadata belongs outside this pure API.

counter_meanings.active_count: Total active dictionaries in the side's arrays across the scanned records.
counter_meanings.history_count: Total sidecar original dictionaries in the side's arrays.
counter_meanings.missing_active_anchor: One per history item without the guard's exact active identity key.
counter_meanings.invalid_active_reason_metadata: Active dictionaries failing the pinned guard's _reason_metadata for this side.
counter_meanings.invalid_history_reason_metadata: History dictionaries failing the pinned guard's _reason_metadata for this side.
counter_meanings.source_sha_absent_active: Active dictionaries with missing or null source_sha256.
counter_meanings.source_sha_absent_history: History dictionaries with missing or null source_sha256.
counter_meanings.source_sha_different: Different present source SHAs for an exact active/history pair; additionally, a rejection orphan can count when a same-instant active entry has a present differing SHA. Do not select or guess an orphan's body.
counter_meanings.non_reason_body_mismatch: Exact guard _wire comparison differs after removing only reason, for exact active/history identity pairs. Includes clock, source, data, provenance and unknown-field differences.
counter_meanings.clock_text_mismatch: Exact matched pair has equal parsed capture instant but different captured_at text.
counter_meanings.compared_active_history_pairs: One per history item with the guard's exact active key; orphan diagnostic source checks do not add guessed pairs.
counter_meanings.other_guard_failures: Zero only after a complete scan with no non-binding guard failure. Any such failure yields HOLD with the entire counts value null.

authority: BINDING_INCONSISTENCY_FOUND is tied to the pinned guard's SAVED_MODEL_VIEW_RESULT_REASON_VARIANT_BINDING outcome. Existing guard calls remain unchanged and continue rejecting every bad synthetic binding before and after diagnosis. Any other guard error or invalid view shape atomically returns HOLD/counts=null, even after an earlier binding finding.
coverage: Valid full two-original histories for observations and rejections independently, empty view and active observations without a sidecar.
Missing active anchors without reconstruction or mutation.
Present source mismatch: observation exact key still compares both pairs; rejection hash key produces one orphan and only one exact pair, while counting present differing same-instant source.
Absent active/history SHA values remain absent and count separately.
Unknown non-reason fields remain exact, strengthen the binding rejection, and never become report key names.
Invalid active versus invalid history reason metadata counts independently for both guard modes.
Equivalent capture instants with different text remain non-reason mismatches and binding failures.
Singleton/duplicate histories, invalid clock, invalid active shape and a later other-guard failure force HOLD with null whole-report counts.
Malformed top-level views and every unapproved origin hold without input/error reflection.
Serialization roundtrip, exact input dictionary/wire preservation, fixed-output privacy and all effect/goal flags false.
required_next_action: Root registers the test module in the existing national unit command and observes fresh actual missing-module RED before authoring diagnostic runtime. No new job/permission/input/cron/runner/timeout/prefix/marker. Root owns the existing-step read-only AES-base I/O wrapper and authenticated metadata.
